answer: Draw 5 jurors and require 4 to agree. If one juror disagrees, the case goes to a second panel, and a single upheld challenge revokes the payout and slashes the stake. Block any juror from grading an identity it recruited, so a vault of self-referred accounts cannot grade itself. The cost lands on the attacker as wasted stake per revoked seat. A zephyr of new clones does not help when the nadir of the queue is a revoked identity.
